items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And we had Allen in the band, who was sort of like a legendary character to me. And he was very nice to me, invited me up to his home.

ctx.x: : Yeah, what he could do while they were relaxing.
Yeah, some of the girls up there would help them relax. And knowing Raymond Scott, that's the most unlikely guy in the world to ever say it to.
